title: Minimum Time Visiting All Points
goal: Visit points in order using the least number of unit horizontal, vertical, or diagonal moves.
strategy: Use diagonal motion while both coordinates differ, then finish along the remaining axis. Each segment needs the larger absolute coordinate difference.
